sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 16:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived at office and completed debrief. Gearing up.
Commencing patrol. Heading towards Aotea Square, doing welfare checks on businesses along the way.
Queen St Starbucks, Localito, McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing sweep.
Area all clear, standing by for security presence and calls.
Heading up Wellesley St towards Federal St.
Sky Tower area, 77 Convenience stores, Eighty Fed and news agency store all clear, no issues. Standing by to show security presence.
Heading towards St Patrick's Cathedral Church; commencing sweep of the area.
Received a call from Glassons about an old male who took photos of the staff and walked away. He was wearing a white shirt and blue pants.
Area all clear, standing by for security presence.
Arrived at lower Albert St; Commercial Bay all clear, Britomart McDonald's all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Fort Lane, Fort St, Coffee Club, Jo & Joe's, Pocket Park, 77 Convenience Store and Wilson Carpark all clear. Heading to check on Gore St.
Tribe and Auckland Harbour Suites all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
High St all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via Kitchener St.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Unichem Pharmacy about a female coming in and going out, but nothing serious.
Lorne St and the library all clear. Heading towards Queen St off Wellesley Street.
Received a call from 203 Queen Street, Ippondo, about a few vagrants outside the store bothering customers. Heading there now.
Arrived at the store and moved the vagrants along professionally with no escalations. Standing by for some time.
Commencing our patrol back on Queen Street.
Businesses from Timezone to OPSM, Unichem Pharmacy and Chemist Warehouse all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's about an aggressive male just leaving the restaurant who said he will come back. Heading there now.

On our way to McDonald's, a couple of vagrants were sitting near Vulcan Avenue corner smoking weed. We went to talk and one vagrant left. The second vagrant got aggressive and started smoking again; we told him to stop but he refused. We informed him of the move-on orders but he was not compliant, got more aggressive and spat on us. We kept professional and kept talking. The vagrant got more aggressive and started walking; we followed him to ensure he was not causing trouble. He walked towards Fort Street via Vulcan Lane and High Street, then towards Quay Street. No further escalations.
Businesses from Kathmandu to Q Convenience Store all clear. Heading towards Britomart McDonald's.
Britomart McDonald's all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.

A young kid approached and said a lady in McDonald's Britomart yelled at him and was rude. We checked with the lady at McDonald's Britomart; she informed us the kid was trying to steal a Lime scooter off another Asian lady, which she intervened and stopped. We checked with the kid and he agreed. On asking where he was from, he said he came by train from GI. He then said he 'was planning to put her to heaven and I have a piece on me.' We understood the intentions and confiscated a small knife (switchblade) off the kid. He said he got it from a store. We immediately informed ASG Management and later informed the police. The kid was later identified as Neriah Wiki, aged 10.
Heading back to HQ for our break.
Received a call from the Auckland Council compliance team about the same kid being held by cops at the Ferry Terminal; heading back there now.
Arrived at the Ferry Terminal; cops are there.
Cops are taking our statement; standing by to give all information. Informed ASG Management about our OT. Details of the kid: Neriah Wiki, aged 10.
Police completed the statement and took the kid into their custody.
Heading back to HQ to complete our shift.
Arrived at HQ; completing Auror report.
Completing handover and shift to the afternoon shift team.
Morning shift overlapped into the afternoon due to the ongoing switchblade situation; reported in detail on the morning shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (16:30 – 19:30)
items: Ops phone charging as battery is at 8%; standing by at office for calls.
Full sweep on Gore / Fort and Tyler St completed, no issues. TK Square all clear.

Commercial Bay all clear, no issues. Areas around Commercial Bay also clear including the bus interchange. Standing by at TK Square for calls; will stand by a bit longer than usual as a big group of delinquents on bikes is at TK Square.
Commencing patrol on Queen Street towards Aotea Square. Welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street, Footlocker, Localito, all clear, no issues.
Aotea Square full sweep, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report.
Heading to Elliott Street to check on the Jungle 8 guard and Elliott Stables.
Customs Street sweep all clear, no issues.
Elliott Street and Jungle 8 all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Heading on Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Heading to Britomart via Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear, no issues to report. Heading to Darby Street; stopping at HQ for a quick bathroom break.
Queen Street all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Darby Street all clear, no issues to report.
Elliott Stables and Jungle 8 welfare check all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Heading back to HQ as one guard will be signing off at 19:30.
Heading to HQ as one guard signs off soon.
One guard signs off and the relieving guard takes over the shift.
One guard signs off. Afternoon shift concluded.
Equipment handover: 2 x Radios, 2 x Body Cams, 1 x Charger, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Vests, 2 x Keytags, Keys.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 4 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived at headquarters to let the standby guards up to the Level 1 office. Commencing patrols.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear, no further issues.
Elliott Stables all clear, no further issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square showing presence.
Welfare check Red Radisson, making our presence known, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Bar 101 and Elliott Stables, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Federal Street, Liston House, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep down Queen Street towards Britomart.

While on patrols, a worker flagged us regarding an aggressive vagrant who had spat on a worker at Vape Haven. We went to investigate with my colleague; the victim told us the suspect spat in his face and was doing drugs. We confronted him and he was then arrested.
Welfare checks on Red Radisson, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Red Radisson requested us to standby as the crowd is getting rowdy; they are shutting the event down at 02:00 and asked us to stay and assist to push everyone out.
Welfare checks down Queen to Britomart.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Take 10, all clear, no further issues to report.
Commencing patrols lower Queen Street towards Chancery Square.
Full sweep all around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort Street and the bottom of High St, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep along Commercial Bay, clear, no issues to report.
My coworker took alcohol off some intoxicated people; I disposed of the alcohol. No issues to report.
Commencing patrols down Customs St towards Queen St, no issues to report.
Commencing sweep of Queen St towards Aotea.
Commencing sweep of Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Commencing sweep of Auckland Library, complete, no issues to report.
Commencing patrols heading towards High Street; completed, High Street all clear, no issues.
Back in office charging ops work phone due to low percentage (10%).
Commencing patrols up Queen Street; had a vagrant sleeping inside McDonald's, told him to move along and he complied without further issues.
Patrolling up Victoria St West; welfare checks on 77 Convenience.
Full sweep around Federal Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Handover to morning shift. Night shift concluded.
